# WeaveSignal

> WeaveSignal is an AGPL-3.0-only radio and video station studio: a LiveKit room for presenters, guests and callers; a desk (Rust, gstreamer-rs) that mixes the programme and a mix-minus for each participant; playout through one fixed Liquidsoap 2.5 script; and listener streams from Liquidsoap's icecast.server. It is in development: release one's milestone M1 is built, with the first slice of the studio app (desk B and the screener, M2). Pages mark everything else as planned, with its milestone. Documentation text is CC BY-SA 4.0; code samples are AGPL-3.0-only.

## Status

- [What is built, and what is planned](/reference/release-one-status/): release one's milestones, M1 to M11

## Tutorials

- [Run a first show at desk B](/tutorials/first-show/): the studio app against the real desk on one machine, with synthetic people

## How-to guides: presenters

- [Get ready to present](/how-to/get-ready/): joining, headphones, the microphone's browser settings
- [Present from the keyboard at desk B](/how-to/present-at-desk-b/): on air, cue, mute, held talk
- [Take a caller to air](/how-to/take-a-caller/): accept with Cue, decline with Esc, drop with Ctrl+D twice
- [Start on the count-in, and take turns](/how-to/count-in/): talkback from the producer or screener; the delay with remote guests
- [When the lamp says PLAYOUT DOWN](/how-to/playout-down/): the room is alive, listeners hear nothing; restart playout

## How-to guides: screeners and station admins

- [Screen callers](/how-to/screen-callers/): hold T to talk, P to send, the chat modes
- [Give someone a room token](/how-to/issue-room-tokens/): short-lived tokens with a role, from the command line or the API
- [Set the show, the rundown and the banned list](/how-to/set-the-show/): temporary settings until the schedule and accounts

## How-to guides: self-hosting

- [Install on Cloudron](/how-to/install-on-cloudron/): the staging package 0.1.1; TURN over TLS on 15349; the private stream; 1.5 GiB
- [Install a station with weavesignal.sh](/how-to/install-with-weavesignal-sh/): the Compose bundle in one command; secrets made locally, free ports, uninstall keeps the data
- [Run the loopback stack with Compose](/how-to/run-with-compose/): every listener on loopback, for development
- [Run a station as Podman Quadlets](/how-to/run-with-quadlets/): units generated from the Compose bundle, secrets as Podman secrets
- [Install the studio app on Linux](/how-to/install-studio-linux/): AppImage, .deb or .rpm; checksums; the Wayland setting
- [Install the studio app on Windows](/how-to/install-studio-windows/): the unsigned installer, its checksum, and SmartScreen's "More info" then "Run anyway"
- [Check a station's ports](/how-to/check-ports/): the free-port check and what to change
